intent: Read-only label + value pair for property display in inspector rows, panels, and tooltips.

layout: horizontal (default; label and value inline, baseline-aligned, value truncates)

slots.value: string or ReactNode; not rendered when undefined

layout.note: hardcoded: horizontal gap-[6px] items-baseline min-w-0 (value truncate); vertical gap-[1px]

a11y.note: Carries no ARIA role or label; the containing row/panel owns any semantic labelling.
a11y.contrast: label (c-text-secondary/tertiary) and value (c-text) vs the surface must meet contrast in light and dark.
